record.name: Consenting NFT-owner buy allocation
record.summary: Give each NFT a lifetime actual launch-token output budget, used only with its current owner’s exact swap consent.

units.amounts: Explicit per-field raw currency units; no currency/value conversion
units.liquidity: Actual v4 liquidity L, not token balances or dollar depth
units.time: Fields distinguish absolute UTC seconds, durations, block counts and Monday UTC weekly offsets
units.identity: Callback sender is usually a router; signatures/NFTs do not imply human diversity

fields.name: sqrtPriceX96
fields.label: Sqrt Price X96
fields.units: Q64.96 sqrt(raw currency1 / raw currency0); not display-token price
fields.help: Enter the raw-unit starting price. Check both token decimals before translating a display price.

fields.name: allocationPerNft
fields.label: Allocation Per Nft
fields.units: raw launch asset units; token decimals are not converted

liveChecks.requirement: Review current ERC721 ownerOf semantics and supported EOA/ERC1271 owner consent; transfers do not reset tokenId lifetime budget.
Must differ from the predicted hook address; nonzero address validation alone is insufficient.
Router consent binds owner/tokenId/router/manager/pool/nonce/deadline/exact swap. Review signer-funded input/output delivery separately. NFT count is not unique people or anti-Sybil identity.

definition.help: Each successful buy consumes the NFT’s remaining allowance. A transfer keeps its spent allowance and requires fresh consent from the new owner. Selling leaves the allowance unchanged. Once an NFT uses its full lifetime allocation, it cannot authorize another buy. The router separately controls payment and token delivery.
